test.title: Something you do regularly to relax

document.cue: Describe something you do regularly to relax.

text: The thing I'd like to describe is swimming. I go to a public pool near my flat three times a week, usually early in the morning before work, and I swim for about forty minutes without stopping.

I started about two years ago, when I was working on a stressful project and sleeping really badly. A colleague suggested swimming, and at first I could only manage four lengths before I had to rest. Now I do about sixty, and I've even started timing myself, although I try not to be too competitive about it.

The pool is quite old, with blue tiles and a big clock on the wall, and at seven in the morning there are only a few regular swimmers. We don't really talk, but we nod to each other, and there's one retired man who always tells me my technique is getting better, which is very kind of him.

It helps me relax because it's the only time in the day when I can't check my phone or think about emails. I just count lengths and listen to my breathing, and after a while my mind goes quiet. I also sleep much better on the days I swim, so the effect lasts all day.
Honestly, it's the best habit I've ever developed.
